verses.en: Now in the twenty and fourth day of this month the children of Israel were assembled with fasting, and with sackclothes, and earth upon them.
verses.sm: O LE aso foi e luafulu ma le fa o.Q lea masina sa faapotopotoina ai le fanauga a Isaraelu, ua anapopogi, ma lavalava ie talatala, ma le eleele i luga ia te i latou.

verses.en: And the seed of Israel separated themselves from all strangers, and stood and confessed their sins, and the iniquities of their fathers.
verses.sm: Ona vavaeeseina lea o le fanau a Isaraelu i tagata ese uma, ma ua latou tutū ma ta‘u atu a latou agasala, ma amio leaga a o latou tamā.

verses.en: And they stood up in their place, and read in the book of the law of the LORD their God one fourth part of the day; and another fourth part they confessed, and worshipped the LORD their God.
verses.sm: Ua latou tutū i luga i le mea na latou i ai, ma ua latou faitau i le tusi o le tulafono a Ieova lo latou Atua o le tasi ona vaega e fa o le aso; o le isi ona vaega e fa foi ua latou ta‘u atu a latou agasala, ma ifo atu ia Ieova lo latou Atua.

verses.en: Then stood up upon the stairs, of the Levites, Jeshua, and Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, and Chenani, and cried with a loud voice unto the LORD their God.
verses.sm: Ona tutū lea i luga i le tulaga o sa Levi, o Iosua, ma Pani, o Katameeli, o Sepania, o. Puni o Serepeia o Pani ma Kanani, ua latou alalaga ma le leo tele ia Ieova lo latou Atua.

verses.en: Then the Levites, Jeshua, and Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabniah, Sherebiah, Hodijah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah, said, Stand up and bless the LORD your God for ever and ever: and blessed be thy glorious name, which is exalted above all blessing and praise.
verses.sm: Ona faapea atu lea o sa Levi, o Iosua, ma Katameeli, o Pani, o Hasapenia, o Serepeia, o Hotia, o Sepania, ma Petakia, Ina tutū ia outou i luga, ina faamanu atu ia Ieova lo outou Atua mai le vavau e oo i le faavavau; ia faamanuina lava lou suafa mamalu ua silisili i faamanu ma viiga uma.

verses.en: Thou, even thou, art LORD alone; thou hast made heaven, the heaven of heavens, with all their host, the earth, and all things that are therein, the seas, and all that is therein, and thou preservest them all; and the host of heaven worshippeth thee.
verses.sm: O oe, na o oe lava o Ieova; na e faia le lagi o le lagi o lagi, ma ‘au uma o i ai, o le lalolagi ma mea uma o i ai, o le sami ma mea uma o i ai, ua e faaola foi ia te i latou uma; ua ifo foi ia te oe ‘au a le lagi.

verses.en: Thou art the LORD the God, who didst choose Abram, and broughtest him forth out of Ur of the Chaldees, and gavest him the name of Abraham;
verses.sm: O oe lava o Ieova le Atua, o le na filifilia Aperamo, ma au mai ia igoa ia te ia i le igoa o Aperaamo;

verses.en: And foundest his heart faithful before thee, and madest a covenant with him to give the land of the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Jebusites, and the Girgashites, to give it, I say, to his seed, and hast performed thy words; for thou art righteous:
verses.sm: na e silafia foi lona loto sa faamaoni i ou luma, na e faia le feagaiga ma ia e foai mai le nuu o sa Kananā, o sa Heti, o sa Amori, ma sa Perise, ma sa Iepuse, ma sa Kirekase, e foai mai i lana fanau; ua e faataunuu foi au afioga; auā o oe o le amiotonu;

verses.en: And didst see the affliction of our fathers in Egypt, and heardest their cry by the Red sea;
verses.sm: na e silafia foi le puapuaga o matou tamā i Aikupito, na e faafofogaina foi la latou alaga i le sami Ulaula;

verses.en: And shewedst signs and wonders upon Pharaoh, and on all his servants, and on all the people of his land: for thou knewest that they dealt proudly against them. So didst thou get thee a name, as it is this day.
verses.sm: na e faia foi faailoga ma vavega ia Farao, ma ana auauna uma, ma tagata uma o lona nuu; auā na e silafia ua latou faamaualuga ia te i latou. Sa faapea ona e maua le viiga e pei ona fai i le aso nei.

verses.en: And thou didst divide the sea before them, so that they went through the midst of the sea on the dry land; and their persecutors thou threwest into the deeps, as a stone into the mighty waters.
verses.sm: Na e vavaeina foi i o latou luma le sami, ia latou ui atu i totonu o le sami i le iliti tai matutu; a o e na tuliloa ia te i latou, na e lafoina i le loloto, e pei o se maa i le sami sousou.

verses.en: Moreover thou leddest them in the day by a cloudy pillar; and in the night by a pillar of fire, to give them light in the way wherein they should go.
verses.sm: O le ao faaniutu na e taita‘iina ai i latou i le ao, o le afi faaniutu foi i le po, e faamalamalama a‘i ia te i latou i le ala latou te o atu ai.

verses.en: Thou camest down also upon mount Sinai, and spakest with them from heaven, and gavest them right judgments, and true laws, good statutes and commandments:
verses.sm: Na e afio ifo foi i luga i le mauga o Sinai, ma fetalai ma i latou mai le lagi, na e tuu mai foi ia te i latou faamasinoga tonu, ma tulafono faamaoni, o sauniga ma poloaiga lelei.

verses.en: And madest known unto them thy holy sabbath, and commandedst them precepts, statutes, and laws, by the hand of Moses thy servant:
verses.sm: Na e faailoa mai foi ia te i latou o lou sapati paia, ma ua poloai mai ia te i latou o poloaiga, ma sauniga, ma tulafono ia Mose lau auauna.

verses.en: And gavest them bread from heaven for their hunger, and broughtest forth water for them out of the rock for their thirst, and promisedst them that they should go in to possess the land which thou hadst sworn to give them.
verses.sm: Na e foai mai foi ia te i latou le mea e ‘ai mai le lagi i lo latou fia aai, ma faapuna mai ia te i latou le vai mai le papa i lo latou fia inu, ua fetalai mai foi ia te i latou, latou te o atu e fai mo latou le nuu na e sii atu ai lou aao e te foaiina mai ia te i latou.

verses.en: But they and our fathers dealt proudly, and hardened their necks, and hearkened not to thy commandments,
verses.sm: A o i latou ma o matou tamā, na latou faamaualuga, ma faamaaa i o latou ua, ma ua latou le faalogo i au poloaiga,

verses.en: And refused to obey, neither were mindful of thy wonders that thou didst among them; but hardened their necks, and in their rebellion appointed a captain to return to their bondage: but thou art a God ready to pardon, gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and of great kindness, and forsookest them not.
verses.sm: ma ua latou le mafafai ona usiusitai, ua latou le manatua foi i ou vavega na e faia ia te i latou; a ua latou faamaaa i o latou ua, o lo latou fouvale foi ua latou tofia ai le ta‘ita‘i e foi atu ai i latou ia nofo pologa. A o oe o le Atua o le faamagaloina sala, o le alofa fua, ma le alofa mutimuti vale, e tele gese lou toasa, ma ua latou.

verses.en: Yea, when they had made them a molten calf, and said, This is thy God that brought thee up out of Egypt, and had wrought great provocations;
verses.sm: E moni, ua latou faia mo i latou le tamai povi auro, ma ua latou fai atu, O lou atua lea o le na aveina ae ia te oe mai Aikupito; ma latou faia mea faaonoono e tele;

verses.en: Yet thou in thy manifold mercies forsookest them not in the wilderness: the pillar of the cloud departed not from them by day, to lead them in the way; neither the pillar of fire by night, to shew them light, and the way wherein they should go.
verses.sm: a o oe, o lou alofa mutimuti vale e tele, na e le tuua ai i latou i le vao; ua le te‘a ma i latou le ao faaniutu i le ao, e ta‘ita‘iina i latou i le ala; ma le afi faaniutu i le po, e faamalamalama a‘i i latou i le ala latou te o atu ai.

verses.en: Thou gavest also thy good spirit to instruct them, and withheldest not thy manna from their mouth, and gavest them water for their thirst.
verses.sm: Na e foai mai foi lou Agaga lelei e a‘oa‘o ia te i latou, na e le taofia foi lau manai ai o latou gutu, na e foai mai foi ia te i latou le vai i lo latou fia inu.

verses.en: Yea, forty years didst thou sustain them in the wilderness, so that they lacked nothing; their clothes waxed not old, and their feet swelled not.
verses.sm: O tausaga foi e fagafulu na e tausia ai i latou i le vao, ua le matitiva i latou, e lei pala o latou ofu, o latou vae foi e lei fulafula.

verses.en: Moreover thou gavest them kingdoms and nations, and didst divide them into corners: so they possessed the land of Sihon, and the land of the king of Heshbon, and the land of Og king of Bashan.
verses.sm: Na e foaiina foi ia te i latou o malo ma nuu, na e vaevaeina foi i latou i itu nuu; ua latou fai foi mo i latou le nuu o Sekono, ma le nuu o le tupu o Hesepona, ma le nuu o Oko le tupu o Vasana.

verses.en: Their children also multipliedst thou as the stars of heaven, and broughtest them into the land, concerning which thou hadst promised to their fathers, that they should go in to possess it.
verses.sm: O a latou fanau foi na e faatoateleina i latou e pei o fetu o le lagi, ua e faaoo foi ia te i latou i le nuu na e fetalai mai ai i o latou tamā, latou te oo i ai e fai mo latou.

verses.en: So the children went in and possessed the land, and thou subduedst before them the inhabitants of the land, the Canaanites, and gavest them into their hands, with their kings, and the people of the land, that they might do with them as they would.
verses.sm: Ua oo mai foi le fanau, ua fai foi mo i latou le nuu, na e faatoilaloina foi i o latou luma o e sa mau i le nuu, o sa Kananā, na e tuuina mai foi i latou i o latou lima, o latou tupu atoa ma tagata o le nuu, ia fai i latou ia te i latou e tusa ma o latou loto.

verses.en: And they took strong cities, and a fat land, and possessed houses full of all goods, wells digged, vineyards, and oliveyards, and fruit trees in abundance: so they did eat, and were filled, and became fat, and delighted themselves in thy great goodness.
verses.sm: Ua faoa e i latou o aai nofo ‘olo, ma laueleele lafulemu, ua latou fai foi mo i latou o fal« sa tutumu i mea lelei uma, o vaieli ua elia, o tovine, ina toolive, ma laau ‘aina e tele; ua latou aai, ma ua maoona, ua puputa foi i latou, ma ua latou fiafia i lou alofa tele.

verses.en: Nevertheless they were disobedient, and rebelled against thee, and cast thy law behind their backs, and slew thy prophets which testified against them to turn them to thee, and they wrought great provocations.
verses.sm: A ua latou vaogatata, ma latou fouvale ia te oe, ua latou lafoaiina foi au tulafono i o latou tua, ua latou fasioti foi au perofeta o e na aoai ia te i latou ia latou foi mai ia te oe, ua faia lava e i latou mea faaonoono e tele.

verses.en: Therefore thou deliveredst them into the hand of their enemies, who vexed them: and in the time of their trouble, when they cried unto thee, thou heardest them from heaven; and according to thy manifold mercies thou gavest them saviours, who saved them out of the hand of their enemies.
verses.sm: O le mea lea na e tuuina atu ai i latou i lima o e ita mai ia te i latou, ua latou faatiga foi ia te i latou; o ona po o lo latou tiga, ua latou alalaga atu ai ia te oe, ona e e foaiina ia te i latou o faitoaga e tusa ma lou alofa mutimuti vale ua tele, na latou faaolaina foi i latou ai lima o e ita mai ia te i latou.

verses.en: But after they had rest, they did evil again before thee: therefore leftest thou them in the hand of their enemies, so that they had the dominion over them: yet when they returned, and cried unto thee, thou heardest them from heaven; and many times didst thou deliver them according to thy mercies;
verses.sm: Ua maua e i latou le filemu, ona latou toe faia lea o amio leaga i ou luma; ona e tuua lea o i latou i lima o e ita mai ia te i latou, na latou faatoilaloina ai i latou; a ua latou toe foi, ma alalaga atu ia te oe, ona e faafofoga mai lea ai le lagi, ma laveai soo ia te i latou e tusa ma lou alofa mutimuti vale;

verses.en: And testifiedst against them, that thou mightest bring them again unto thy law: yet they dealt proudly, and hearkened not unto thy commandments, but sinned against thy judgments, (which if a man do, he shall live in them;) and withdrew the shoulder, and hardened their neck, and would not hear.
verses.sm: na e aoai foi ia te i latou, ina ia e faafoi mai ia te i latou i lau tulafono; a ua latou faamaualuga, ma ua latou le faalogo i au poloaiga, ua latou agasala foi i au faamasinoga, (a anaana i ai se tagata e ola ai lava ia;) a ua ‘alo o latou tau‘au, ma ua latou faamaaa i o latou ua, ma ua latou le faalogo.

verses.en: Yet many years didst thou forbear them, and testifiedst against them by thy spirit in thy prophets: yet would they not give ear: therefore gavest thou them into the hand of the people of the lands.
verses.sm: A e tele tausaga na e onosai ai ia te i latou, ma aoai ia te i latou e ou Agaga na i au perofeta; a ua latou le faalogo; ona e tuu atu ai lea ia te i latou i lima o tagata o ia nuu.

verses.en: Nevertheless for thy great mercies' sake thou didst not utterly consume them, nor forsake them; for thou art a gracious and merciful God.
verses.sm: A ona o lou alofa mutimuti vale ua tele, na e le matuā faaumatia ai i latou, ma e le tuulafoai ia te i latou; auā o oe o le Atua alofa fua ma le alofa mutimuti vale.

verses.en: Now therefore, our God, the great, the mighty, and the terrible God, who keepest covenant and mercy, let not all the trouble seem little before thee, that hath come upon us, on our kings, on our princes, and on our priests, and on our prophets, and on our fathers, and on all thy people, since the time of the kings of Assyria unto this day.
verses.sm: O lenei, lo matou Atua e, o le Atua silisili, o le mana, ma le matautia, o le tausi le feagaiga ma le alofa, aua ne‘i e manatu ua itiiti le tiga uma ua oo mai ia te i matou, ma o matou tupu, ma o matou alii, ma a matou faitaulaga, ma a matou perofeta, ma o matou tamā, ma lou nuu uma, talu ona po o tupu o Asuria ua oo mai i lenei aso.

verses.en: Howbeit thou art just in all that is brought upon us; for thou hast done right, but we have done wickedly:
verses.sm: A o oe, ua tonu lava oe i mea uma ua oo mai ia te i matou; auā ua e faamaoni, a o i matou, ua matou amio leaga;

verses.en: Neither have our kings, our princes, our priests, nor our fathers, kept thy law, nor hearkened unto thy commandments and thy testimonies, wherewith thou didst testify against them.
verses.sm: e lei faia foi lau tulafono e o matou tupu, o matou alii, o a matou faitaulaga, ma o matou tamā, ua latou le faalogo foi i au poloaiga ma au faatonuga, na e faatonu mai ai ia te i latou.

verses.en: For they have not served thee in their kingdom, and in thy great goodness that thou gavest them, and in the large and fat land which thou gavest before them, neither turned they from their wicked works.
verses.sm: Auā na latou le auauna ia te oe i lo latou malo, ma lou alofa tele na e foai mai ai ia te i atou, ma le nuu tele ma le lafulemu na e tuuina mai i o latou luma, ma ua latou le foi mai i a latou amio leaga.

verses.en: Behold, we are servants this day, and for the land that thou gavest unto our fathers to eat the fruit thereof and the good thereof, behold, we are servants in it:
verses.sm: Faauta, o pologa i matou i le aso nei; o le nuu foi na e foai mai i o matou tamā e aai i ona fua ma ana mea lelei, faauta, o pologa i matou i ai;

verses.en: And it yieldeth much increase unto the kings whom thou hast set over us because of our sins: also they have dominion over our bodies, and over our cattle, at their pleasure, and we are in great distress.
verses.sm: e tutupu mai ai foi mea e tele mā tupu ua e tuuina mai e pule ia te i matou ona o a matou agasala; ua latou pule foi i o matou tino, ma a matou manu, i lo latou faitalia, e tele foi lo matou puapuaga.

verses.en: And because of all this we make a sure covenant, and write it; and our princes, Levites, and priests, seal unto it.
verses.sm: Ona o ia mea uma foi ua matou fai ai le feagaiga moni, ma tusi ai; ua faamaufaailogaina foi e o matou alii, ma o matou tagata sa LevT, ma a matou faitaulaga. 0 igoa o e na faamaufaailogaina le
